source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: [Aura](vsdata:core-rule/aura-abilities). When your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) finishes, identify all enemy units at most 6″ away from this model and roll one D6 per unit. A 2–3 deals 1 [mortal wound](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds), a 4–5 deals D3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds), and a 6 deals D6 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) to the unit rolled for.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
